release_notes: The HikMicro HM-TD1218-2 is a bi-spectrum turret camera fusing a 160x120 thermal module with a 5 MP optical channel for perimeter protection and early fire prevention. It offers VCA 3.0 human/vehicle classification, fire-point and smoking detection, and temperature exception alarms (-20 to 150 C).

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80, Profile S/G). Thermal + optical exposed as separate channels.
